purpose: Necessary conditions, quantifiers, objects, limits, normalisations and re-counting boundaries for using the material. Recorded from source; no hypothesis is added to any author statement.

global_standing_assumptions.item: finite rooted maps, distinguished oriented edge
planar model M_n(s_n,0); unicellular model M_n(1,(s_n-1)/2) with s_n odd

per_candidate_boundaries.objects: uniform rooted M_n(s_n,0) genus 0 and M_n(1,(s_n-1)/2) unicellular, n edges, sparsity s_n
per_candidate_boundaries.quantifier_order: one limit over sequences s_n -> infinity, s_n/n -> 0. No uniformity in s_n, no joint limit with the defect theorem, no result for general (f_n,g_n).
per_candidate_boundaries.topology_and_mode: convergence in distribution for the local pointed Gromov-Hausdorff topology; not in probability, not compact Gromov-Hausdorff, not Hausdorff distance
per_candidate_boundaries.scale_and_normalisation: sqrt(s_n/n) multiplying the discrete metric. Equivalent statements: edge lengths exponential with mean 1/sqrt(6) = 1/(2 kappa), kappa = sqrt(3/2)
per_candidate_boundaries.limit_objects: planar: dual of type-1 UIPT after inserting a middle vertex on the root edge and grafting a dangling leaf; unicellular: deterministic infinite three-regular tree with the same root transformation
per_candidate_boundaries.edge_decoration: independent copies of P^bullet, the push-forward of kappa times the size-biased drift excursion measure on pairs (excursion, time) under the CRT projection; pointing at the outer tip of the dangling-leaf CRT
per_candidate_boundaries.discrete_to_continuum_correspondence: kernel -> local limit graph; core chains -> exponential segments; corner forests -> Poisson cloud of CRTs on the cable graph, equivalence by Bismut decomposition
must_not_strengthen: distribution to almost sure or probability
independence of edge decorations to any dependence
